operators.name: Arc length
operators.formula: s = r θ   (θ in radians)

operators.name: Circle area
operators.formula: A = π r²

operators.name: Circle circumference
operators.formula: C = 2 π r

operators.name: Cone surface area
operators.formula: SA = π r (r + l),  l = slant height

operators.name: Cone volume
operators.formula: V = ⅓ π r² h

operators.name: Cube surface area
operators.formula: SA = 6 s²

operators.name: Cube volume
operators.formula: V = s³

operators.name: Cylinder surface area
operators.formula: SA = 2 π r (r + h)

operators.name: Cylinder volume
operators.formula: V = π r² h

operators.name: Degrees to radians (Geometry)
operators.formula: radians = degrees × π / 180

operators.name: Distance formula
operators.formula: d = √((x₂ − x₁)² + (y₂ − y₁)²)

operators.name: Heron's formula: area
operators.formula: A = √(s(s−a)(s−b)(s−c))   (s is the semi-perimeter, from the row above)

operators.name: Heron's formula: semi-perimeter
operators.formula: s = (a + b + c) / 2   (half the distance round the triangle)

operators.name: Law of cosines
operators.formula: c = √(a² + b² − 2ab cos C)   (C in radians)

operators.name: Law of sines
operators.formula: b = a · sin B / sin A   (angles in radians)

operators.name: Parallelogram area
operators.formula: A = base · height

operators.name: Polygon interior angle sum
operators.formula: sum of interior angles = (n − 2) × 180°

operators.name: Pyramid volume
operators.formula: V = ⅓ · base area · height

operators.name: Pythagorean theorem
operators.formula: c = √(a² + b²)   (hypotenuse of a right triangle)

operators.name: Radians to degrees (Geometry)
operators.formula: degrees = radians × 180 / π

operators.name: Rectangle area
operators.formula: A = l · w

operators.name: Rectangular prism surface area
operators.formula: SA = 2(lw + lh + wh)

operators.name: Rectangular prism volume
operators.formula: V = l · w · h

operators.name: Regular polygon area
operators.formula: A = ½ · perimeter · apothem

operators.name: Rhombus area
operators.formula: A = ½ d₁ d₂

operators.name: Sector area
operators.formula: A = ½ r² θ   (θ in radians)

operators.name: Slope
operators.formula: m = (y₂ − y₁) / (x₂ − x₁)

operators.name: Sphere surface area
operators.formula: SA = 4 π r²

operators.name: Sphere volume
operators.formula: V = 4/3 π r³

operators.name: Square area
operators.formula: A = s²

operators.name: Trapezoid area
operators.formula: A = ½ (a + b) h

operators.name: Triangle area
operators.formula: A = ½ · base · height

operators.name: Alternating group order
operators.formula: |Aₙ| = n!/2   (even permutations, n ≥ 2)

operators.name: Basis
operators.formula: A linearly independent set that spans the vector space

operators.name: Coset
operators.formula: gH = { g∘h : h ∈ H }

operators.name: Cyclic group
operators.formula: A group generated by a single element g: {…, g⁻¹, e, g, g², …}

operators.name: Dimension
operators.formula: The number of vectors in any basis of V

operators.name: Direct product
operators.formula: G × H = { (g, h) : g ∈ G, h ∈ H }

operators.name: Direct sum
operators.formula: A ⊕ B = { (a, b) : a ∈ A, b ∈ B } with component-wise operations; dim(A ⊕ B) = dim A + dim B

operators.name: Direct sum: dimension
operators.formula: dim(A ⊕ B) = dim A + dim B
operators.pattern: dim ( A ⊕ B ) = dim A + dim B

operators.name: Field
operators.formula: A commutative ring where every non-zero element has a multiplicative inverse
operators.pattern: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide by nonzero elements with □

operators.name: Field extension
operators.formula: A field K that contains F as a subfield; [K:F] = dimension of K as an F-vector space

operators.name: Field extension: degree
operators.formula: [K:F] = dim_F K   (the dimension of K as a vector space over F)

operators.name: Galois group
operators.formula: The group of automorphisms of K that fix F

operators.name: Group
operators.formula: A set G with an operation ∘ that is closed, associative, has an identity e, and every element has an inverse

operators.name: Homomorphism
operators.formula: A map with φ(a∘b) = φ(a)∘φ(b)

operators.name: Ideal
operators.formula: A subring I with r·i and i·r in I for all r ∈ R, i ∈ I

operators.name: Image
operators.formula: im φ = { φ(g) : g ∈ G }

operators.name: Integral domain
operators.formula: A commutative ring with 1 ≠ 0 and no zero divisors
operators.pattern: a × b = 0 ⇒ a = 0 or b = 0 with □

operators.name: Isomorphism
operators.formula: A bijective homomorphism; G ≅ H means G and H have the same structure

operators.name: Kernel
operators.formula: ker φ = { g ∈ G : φ(g) = e_H }

operators.name: Module
operators.formula: Like a vector space but over a ring R instead of a field

operators.name: Normal subgroup
operators.formula: A subgroup N with gNg⁻¹ = N for every g in G

operators.name: Order of element
operators.formula: smallest k > 0 with gᵏ = e   (op = the group operation)

operators.name: Order of group
operators.formula: |G| = number of elements of G

operators.name: Polynomial ring
operators.formula: All polynomials a₀ + a₁x + … + aₙxⁿ with coefficients in R

operators.name: Ring
operators.formula: A set with addition (an abelian group) and associative multiplication that distributes over addition

operators.name: Subgroup
operators.formula: A subset H of G that is itself a group under the same operation

operators.name: Symmetric group order
operators.formula: |Sₙ| = n!   (all permutations of n objects)

operators.name: Tensor product
operators.formula: (a ⊗ b) = (a₁b₁, a₁b₂, …, aₘbₙ)   (Kronecker product of two vectors)

operators.name: Vector space
operators.formula: A set with vector addition and scalar multiplication over a field satisfying the vector space axioms

operators.name: Arithmetic sequence
operators.formula: aₙ = a₁ + (n − 1)d

operators.name: Binomial theorem
operators.formula: (a + b)ⁿ = Σₖ C(n,k) · aⁿ⁻ᵏ · bᵏ

operators.name: Complex conjugate
operators.formula: conj(a + bi) = a − bi

operators.name: Complex number
operators.formula: z = a + bi

operators.name: Cube
operators.formula: x³ = x · x · x

operators.name: Cube root
operators.formula: ∛x  (y such that y³ = x)

operators.name: Difference of squares
operators.formula: a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)  (returns the two factors)

operators.name: Discriminant
operators.formula: Δ = b² − 4ac  (>0: two real roots, 0: one, <0: complex)

operators.name: Expand
operators.formula: Multiply out products, e.g. (x + 1)(x − 1) = x² − 1

operators.name: Exponential
operators.formula: eˣ

operators.name: Factor
operators.formula: Rewrite a polynomial as a product of lower-degree polynomials, e.g. x² − 1 = (x − 1)(x + 1)

operators.name: Geometric sequence
operators.formula: aₙ = a₁ · rⁿ⁻¹

operators.name: Imaginary unit
operators.formula: i² = −1

operators.name: Log any base
operators.formula: logₐ(x) = ln(x) / ln(a)

operators.name: Log base 10
operators.formula: log₁₀(x)

operators.name: Modulus of complex number
operators.formula: |a + bi| = √(a² + b²)

operators.name: Natural log
operators.formula: ln(x) = logₑ(x)

operators.name: Power
operators.formula: aᵇ

operators.name: Simplify
operators.formula: Rewrite an expression in an equivalent, shorter or standard form

operators.name: Slope-intercept form
operators.formula: y = m·x + b

operators.name: Solve for x
operators.formula: Find the value(s) of x that make an equation true

operators.name: Solve system of equations
operators.formula: Find values satisfying several equations at once; for linear systems solve Ax = b

operators.name: Square
operators.formula: x² = x · x

operators.name: Square root
operators.formula: √x  (y such that y² = x)

operators.name: Absolute value
operators.formula: |x| = x if x ≥ 0, otherwise −x

operators.name: Addition
operators.formula: a + b

operators.name: Division
operators.formula: a ÷ b

operators.name: Fraction
operators.formula: numerator / denominator

operators.name: Maximum
operators.formula: max(a, b, …) = largest value

operators.name: Minimum
operators.formula: min(a, b, …) = smallest value

operators.name: Modulo
operators.formula: a mod b = a − b·⌊a/b⌋  (remainder of a ÷ b)

operators.name: Multiplication
operators.formula: a × b

operators.name: Negate
operators.formula: −x  (flip the sign)

operators.name: Round down
operators.formula: ⌊x⌋ = greatest integer ≤ x

operators.name: Round nearest
operators.formula: round(x) = nearest integer to x

operators.name: Round up
operators.formula: ⌈x⌉ = smallest integer ≥ x

operators.name: Subtraction
operators.formula: a − b

operators.name: Curl
operators.formula: ∇×F = (∂Fz/∂y − ∂Fy/∂z, ∂Fx/∂z − ∂Fz/∂x, ∂Fy/∂x − ∂Fx/∂y)

operators.name: Definite integral
operators.formula: ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx   (numerical: Simpson's rule with n subintervals)

operators.name: Derivative
operators.formula: f′(x) = lim_{h→0} (f(x+h) − f(x−h)) / 2h   (numerical central difference)

operators.name: Differential equation
operators.formula: An equation relating a function to its derivatives; see the Euler / Runge–Kutta operators to solve numerically

operators.name: Divergence
operators.formula: ∇·F = ∂Fx/∂x + ∂Fy/∂y + ∂Fz/∂z

operators.name: Double integral
operators.formula: ∬_R f(x, y) dA = ∫∫ f(x, y) dy dx over a region R

operators.name: Gradient
operators.formula: ∇f = (∂f/∂x₁, …, ∂f/∂xₙ)   (numerical)

operators.name: Indefinite integral
operators.formula: ∫ f(x) dx = F(x) + C   where F′(x) = f(x)

operators.name: Infinity
operators.formula: ∞ = value larger than any real number

operators.name: L'Hopital's rule
operators.formula: If lim f/g is 0/0 or ∞/∞ then lim f/g = lim f′/g′  (when that limit exists)

operators.name: Laplacian
operators.formula: Δf = ∂²f/∂x² + ∂²f/∂y² + ∂²f/∂z²

operators.name: Limit
operators.formula: lim_{x→a} f(x) = L  means f(x) gets arbitrarily close to L as x gets close to a

operators.name: Line integral
operators.formula: ∮_C F · dr = ∫ₐᵇ F(r(t)) · r′(t) dt   (∮ when C is a closed curve)

operators.name: Maclaurin series
operators.formula: f(x) ≈ Σₙ f⁽ⁿ⁾(0)/n! · xⁿ   (Taylor series about 0)

operators.name: Partial derivative
operators.formula: ∂f/∂xᵢ ≈ (f(…xᵢ+h…) − f(…xᵢ−h…)) / 2h   (point is a list, i is the variable index)

operators.name: Product
operators.formula: ∏ aᵢ = a₁ · a₂ · … · aₙ

operators.name: Product rule
operators.formula: (f·g)′ = f′g + fg′

operators.name: Quotient rule
operators.formula: (f/g)′ = (f′g − fg′) / g²

operators.name: Second derivative
operators.formula: f″(x) ≈ (f(x+h) − 2f(x) + f(x−h)) / h²

operators.name: Second partial derivative
operators.formula: ∂²f/∂xᵢ² ≈ (f(…xᵢ+h…) − 2f(…) + f(…xᵢ−h…)) / h²   (point is a list, i is the variable index)

operators.name: Summation
operators.formula: Σ aᵢ = a₁ + a₂ + … + aₙ

operators.name: Taylor series
operators.formula: f(x) ≈ Σₙ f⁽ⁿ⁾(a)/n! · (x − a)ⁿ   (derivs = [f(a), f′(a), f″(a), …])

operators.name: Triple integral
operators.formula: ∭_V f(x, y, z) dV = ∫∫∫ f(x, y, z) dz dy dx over a volume V
operators.compute_signature: compute(f, x0, x1, y0, y1, z0, z1)

operators.name: Adjunction
operators.formula: Hom(F(A), B) ≅ Hom(A, G(B)) naturally

operators.name: Aleph-null
operators.formula: The cardinality of the natural numbers

operators.name: Axiom of choice
operators.formula: Every collection of non-empty sets has a choice function

operators.name: Bijective
operators.formula: both injective and surjective

operators.name: Cartesian product
operators.formula: A × B = { (a, b) : a ∈ A, b ∈ B }

operators.name: Category
operators.formula: Objects and morphisms with composition (associative) and identity morphisms

operators.name: Complex numbers
operators.formula: { a + bi : a, b ∈ ℝ }

operators.name: Function
operators.formula: A rule assigning to each element of A exactly one element of B

operators.name: Functor
operators.formula: A map between categories preserving composition and identities

operators.name: Injective
operators.formula: f(x) = f(y) ⇒ x = y

operators.name: Limit and colimit
operators.formula: Universal cone over (or cocone under) a diagram

operators.name: Morphism
operators.formula: An arrow from object A to object B in a category

operators.name: Natural transformation
operators.formula: A family of morphisms ηₓ: F(X) → G(X) that commute with F(f) and G(f)

operators.name: Omega ordinal
operators.formula: The first infinite ordinal, the order type of the natural numbers

operators.name: Power set
operators.formula: 𝒫(A) = set of all subsets of A;  |𝒫(A)| = 2^|A|

operators.name: Product and coproduct
operators.formula: Universal objects with projections (product) or injections (coproduct)

operators.name: Quaternions
operators.formula: { a + bi + cj + dk } with i² = j² = k² = ijk = −1

operators.name: Rational numbers
operators.formula: { p/q : p, q ∈ ℤ, q ≠ 0 }

operators.name: Real numbers
operators.formula: The complete ordered field: all rational and irrational numbers

operators.name: Surjective
operators.formula: every element of the codomain is f(x) for some x

operators.name: Zorn's lemma
operators.formula: If every chain in a poset has an upper bound, then the poset has a maximal element
operators.pattern: Chains have upper bounds ⇒ a maximal element exists

operators.name: Analytic function
operators.formula: A function complex-differentiable in a neighborhood of every point of its domain
operators.pattern: Locally equal to a convergent power series

operators.name: Argument
operators.formula: arg(a + bi) = atan2(b, a)

operators.name: Branch cut
operators.formula: A curve removed from the complex plane so a multi-valued function (e.g. log, √) becomes single-valued

operators.name: Cauchy integral formula
operators.formula: f(a) = (1 / 2πi) ∮ f(z) / (z − a) dz

operators.name: Cauchy–Riemann equations
operators.formula: f = u + iv is complex-differentiable only if ∂u/∂x = ∂v/∂y and ∂u/∂y = −∂v/∂x

operators.name: Conformal map
operators.formula: An angle-preserving map; any analytic function with f′ ≠ 0 is conformal

operators.name: Contour integral
operators.formula: ∮_C f(z) dz = ∫ f(γ(t)) γ′(t) dt

operators.name: De Moivre's theorem
operators.formula: (r(cos θ + i sin θ))ⁿ = rⁿ(cos nθ + i sin nθ)
operators.pattern: ( □ ( cos □ + i sin □ ) ) ⁿ = □ ⁿ ( cos □ □ + i sin □ □ )

operators.name: Euler's formula
operators.formula: e^(iθ) = cos θ + i sin θ

operators.name: Imaginary part
operators.formula: Im(a + bi) = b

operators.name: Mobius transformation
operators.formula: f(z) = (az + b) / (cz + d),  ad − bc ≠ 0

operators.name: Real part
operators.formula: Re(a + bi) = a

operators.name: Residue
operators.formula: The coefficient of 1/(z − a) in the Laurent series of f about a

operators.name: Residue theorem
operators.formula: ∮_C f(z) dz = 2πi Σ Res(f, aₖ) over poles aₖ inside C

operators.name: Approximately equal
operators.formula: a ≈ b  (equal within a small tolerance)

operators.name: Close bracket
operators.formula: ) ends a group opened by (

operators.name: Curly braces
operators.formula: { … } denote a set or a group of terms

operators.name: Equals
operators.formula: a = b

operators.name: Greater than
operators.formula: a > b

operators.name: Greater than or equal
operators.formula: a ≥ b

operators.name: Less than
operators.formula: a < b

operators.name: Less than or equal
operators.formula: a ≤ b

operators.name: Not equal
operators.formula: a ≠ b

operators.name: Open bracket
operators.formula: ( begins a group; what is inside is evaluated first

operators.name: Pi
operators.formula: π = circumference / diameter ≈ 3.14159265…

operators.name: Proportional to
operators.formula: y ∝ x  means y = k·x;  returns the constant k = y / x

operators.name: Square brackets
operators.formula: [ … ] group an expression, or denote a closed interval [a, b] / a list

operators.name: Christoffel symbol
operators.formula: Γᵏᵢⱼ = ½ gᵏˡ (∂ᵢgⱼˡ + ∂ⱼgᵢˡ − ∂ˡgᵢⱼ)

operators.name: Differential form
operators.formula: A smooth, antisymmetric, multilinear field that can be integrated over manifolds

operators.name: Exterior derivative
operators.formula: d(f dx) = df ∧ dx,  d² = 0

operators.name: Exterior derivative: d squared is zero
operators.formula: d² = 0

operators.name: Gaussian curvature
operators.formula: K = κ₁ · κ₂  (product of the principal curvatures)

operators.name: Geodesic
operators.formula: A locally shortest path; ẍᵏ + Γᵏᵢⱼ ẋⁱ ẋʲ = 0

operators.name: Lie bracket
operators.formula: [X, Y] f = X(Y f) − Y(X f)

operators.name: Lie derivative
operators.formula: The rate of change of a tensor field along the flow of the vector field X

operators.name: Metric tensor
operators.formula: gᵢⱼ gives lengths and angles: ds² = gᵢⱼ dxⁱ dxʲ

operators.name: Pullback
operators.formula: (f*ω)(v) = ω(df(v))

operators.name: Ricci tensor
operators.formula: Rᵢⱼ = Rᵏᵢₖⱼ  (contraction of the Riemann tensor)

operators.name: Riemann curvature
operators.formula: Measures how parallel transport around a small loop fails to return a vector unchanged

operators.name: Stokes' theorem
operators.formula: The integral of dω over M equals the integral of ω over the boundary ∂M

operators.name: Tangent space
operators.formula: The vector space of all tangent vectors at p

operators.name: Tangent vector
operators.formula: The velocity vector of a curve through p on a manifold

operators.name: Tensor contraction
operators.formula: Sum over a paired upper and lower index, lowering the tensor's rank by 2

operators.name: Wedge product
operators.formula: α ∧ β = −β ∧ α  (antisymmetric product of differential forms)

operators.name: Euler's totient
operators.formula: φ(n) = number of integers in 1…n that are coprime to n = n · ∏(1 − 1/p)

operators.name: Fibonacci
operators.formula: F₀ = 0, F₁ = 1, Fₙ = Fₙ₋₁ + Fₙ₋₂
operators.pattern: □ ₀ = 0 , □ ₁ = 1 , □ ₙ = □ ₙ₋₁ + □ ₙ₋₂ with □

operators.name: Greatest common divisor
operators.formula: largest integer dividing both a and b

operators.name: Least common multiple
operators.formula: lcm(a, b) = |a·b| / gcd(a, b)

operators.name: Modular arithmetic
operators.formula: a ≡ r (mod m) where r = a − m·⌊a/m⌋

operators.name: Pigeonhole principle
operators.formula: Putting n items in m boxes forces some box to hold at least ⌈n/m⌉ items

operators.name: Prime check
operators.formula: n is prime if n > 1 and has no divisor other than 1 and n

operators.name: Prime factorization
operators.formula: every integer > 1 is a product of primes

operators.name: Adjacency matrix
operators.formula: Aᵢⱼ = 1 if vertices i and j are joined (undirected), else 0

operators.name: Bell number
operators.formula: Bₙ = Σₖ S(n, k)   (number of partitions of an n-element set)

operators.name: Bipartite graph
operators.formula: Vertices split into two sets with edges only between the sets (no odd cycles)

operators.name: Burnside's lemma
operators.formula: Number of orbits = (1/|G|) Σ_g |Fix(g)|

operators.name: Chromatic number
operators.formula: The smallest number of colors needed to color vertices so adjacent vertices differ

operators.name: Cycle
operators.formula: A path that returns to its starting vertex

operators.name: Euler path
operators.formula: A path using every edge exactly once; exists iff the graph is connected with 0 or 2 odd-degree vertices

operators.name: Generating function
operators.formula: G(x) = Σ aₙ xⁿ  encodes the sequence a₀, a₁, a₂, …

operators.name: Graph
operators.formula: A set of vertices V and a set of edges E joining pairs of vertices

operators.name: Hamiltonian path
operators.formula: A path visiting every vertex exactly once

operators.name: Max flow min cut
operators.formula: The maximum flow from source to sink equals the capacity of the minimum cut

operators.name: Partition number
operators.formula: p(n) = number of ways to write n as a sum of positive integers (order ignored)

operators.name: Path
operators.formula: A sequence of distinct vertices where consecutive vertices are joined by edges

operators.name: Planar graph
operators.formula: Can be drawn in the plane without crossing edges; then E ≤ 3V − 6 (V ≥ 3)

operators.name: Recurrence relation
operators.formula: Defines each term from earlier terms, e.g. Fibonacci Fₙ = Fₙ₋₁ + Fₙ₋₂

operators.name: Shortest path (Dijkstra)
operators.formula: Dijkstra's algorithm; graph = {node: [(neighbor, weight), …]}, returns {node: distance}

operators.name: Spanning tree
operators.formula: A tree that contains every vertex of G

operators.name: Stirling number (second kind)
operators.formula: S(n, k) = (1/k!) Σⱼ (−1)ʲ C(k, j) (k − j)ⁿ

operators.name: Tree
operators.formula: A connected graph with no cycles; a tree on n vertices has n − 1 edges

operators.name: Vertex degree
operators.formula: deg(v) = number of edges at v   (graph = {vertex: [neighbors]})

operators.name: Angle between two orientations
operators.formula: ∠ = 2 acos(|q₀ · q₁|) with both quaternions normalised (q and −q are the same orientation), from 0 to π radians

operators.name: Characteristic polynomial
operators.formula: p(λ) = det(A − λI);  for 2×2: λ² − tr(A)·λ + det(A)  (returns [1, −tr, det])

operators.name: Column space
operators.formula: col(A) = span of the columns of A = { A·x : x }

operators.name: Cross product
operators.formula: a × b = (a₂b₃ − a₃b₂, a₃b₁ − a₁b₃, a₁b₂ − a₂b₁)   (3D vectors)

operators.name: Determinant
operators.formula: det(A) = Σⱼ (−1)ʲ · A₀ⱼ · det(minor₀ⱼ)   (cofactor expansion along row 0)

operators.name: Dot product
operators.formula: a·b = Σ aᵢbᵢ = |a||b|cos θ

operators.name: Eigenvalues
operators.formula: det(A − λI) = 0   (closed form for a 2×2 matrix: λ = (tr ± √(tr² − 4·det)) / 2)

operators.name: Eigenvectors
operators.formula: A·v = λ·v  — solve (A − λI)v = 0 for v ≠ 0 for each eigenvalue λ

operators.name: Identity matrix
operators.formula: Iᵢⱼ = 1 if i = j else 0
operators.pattern: I ᵢⱼ = 1 when i = j , 0 otherwise with □

operators.name: LU decomposition
operators.formula: A = L·U with L lower-triangular and U upper-triangular

operators.name: Matrix add
operators.formula: (A + B)ᵢⱼ = Aᵢⱼ + Bᵢⱼ

operators.name: Matrix inverse
operators.formula: A·A⁻¹ = I   (Gauss–Jordan elimination)

operators.name: Matrix multiply
operators.formula: (AB)ᵢⱼ = Σₖ Aᵢₖ · Bₖⱼ

operators.name: Matrix rank
operators.formula: rank(A) = number of linearly independent rows (pivots after elimination)

operators.name: Matrix subtract
operators.formula: (A − B)ᵢⱼ = Aᵢⱼ − Bᵢⱼ

operators.name: Null space
operators.formula: null(A) = { x : A·x = 0 }

operators.name: QR decomposition
operators.formula: A = Q·R with Q orthogonal (QᵀQ = I) and R upper-triangular

operators.name: Quaternion conjugate
operators.formula: q* = w − x i − y j − z k

operators.name: Quaternion from axis and angle
operators.formula: q = cos(θ/2) + sin(θ/2) · (the unit axis)

operators.name: Yaw, pitch and roll to quaternion
operators.formula: q = q_yaw q_pitch q_roll, with q_roll = [cos(r/2), sin(r/2), 0, 0], q_pitch = [cos(p/2), 0, sin(p/2), 0], q_yaw = [cos(y/2), 0, 0, sin(y/2)]

operators.name: Quaternion inverse
operators.formula: q⁻¹ = q* / (w² + x² + y² + z²)

operators.name: Quaternion multiply
operators.formula: Hamilton product of two quaternions (w, x, y, z), the second turn done first

operators.name: Quaternion normalise
operators.formula: q̂ = q / √(w² + x² + y² + z²)

operators.name: Quaternion blend
operators.formula: slerp(q₀, q₁, t) = (sin((1 − t)ω) q₀ + sin(tω) q₁) / sin ω, ω = acos(q₀ · q₁); the short way round (q and −q are the same turn)

operators.name: Quaternion to yaw, pitch and roll
operators.formula: yaw = atan2(2(wz + xy), 1 − 2(y² + z²)),  pitch = asin(2(wy − zx)),  roll = atan2(2(wx + yz), 1 − 2(x² + y²))  (q normalised first)

operators.name: Rotate a vector by a matrix
operators.formula: R v: the three rows of R times v

operators.name: Rotate a vector
operators.formula: v turned by q: q v q⁻¹ (the axes stay fixed; a q that is not unit length is allowed)

operators.name: Rotation matrix from axis and angle
operators.formula: the quaternion cos(θ/2) + sin(θ/2) · (the unit axis), then R(q); the axis is normalised first, the angle is in radians

operators.name: Rotation matrix from a quaternion
operators.formula: R(q) from the normalised quaternion (w, x, y, z): [1 − 2(y² + z²), 2(xy − zw), 2(xz + yw)], [2(xy + zw), 1 − 2(x² + z²), 2(yz − xw)], [2(xz − yw), 2(yz + xw), 1 − 2(x² + y²)]

operators.name: Rotation matrix from yaw, pitch and roll
operators.formula: the quaternion q_yaw q_pitch q_roll, then R(q)

operators.name: Quaternion from a rotation matrix
operators.formula: Shepperd's method: the largest of w, x, y, z is found first; the answer has w ≥ 0

operators.name: Row reduce (RREF)
operators.formula: Reduced row echelon form via Gauss–Jordan elimination

operators.name: Scalar multiply
operators.formula: (kA)ᵢⱼ = k · Aᵢⱼ

operators.name: Singular value decomposition
operators.formula: A = U·Σ·Vᵀ with U, V orthogonal and Σ diagonal of singular values

operators.name: Solve Ax = b
operators.formula: Solve the linear system A·x = b  (Gaussian elimination with partial pivoting)

operators.name: Trace
operators.formula: tr(A) = Σᵢ Aᵢᵢ  (sum of the diagonal)

operators.name: Transpose
operators.formula: (Aᵀ)ᵢⱼ = Aⱼᵢ

operators.name: Vector magnitude
operators.formula: ‖v‖ = √(v₁² + v₂² + …)

operators.name: Vector projection
operators.formula: proj_b(a) = (a·b / b·b) · b

operators.name: AND
operators.formula: A ∧ B is true only when both are true

operators.name: Cardinality
operators.formula: |A| = number of elements in A

operators.name: Complement
operators.formula: Aᶜ = elements of the universal set U not in A

operators.name: Element of
operators.formula: x ∈ S  — x is a member of S

operators.name: Empty set
operators.formula: ∅ = the set with no elements

operators.name: For all
operators.formula: ∀x ∈ D: P(x)  — P holds for every x in D

operators.name: If and only if
operators.formula: A ↔ B is true when A and B have the same truth value

operators.name: Implies
operators.formula: A → B is false only when A is true and B is false  (¬A ∨ B)

operators.name: Intersection
operators.formula: A ∩ B = elements in both A and B

operators.name: NOT
operators.formula: ¬A is true when A is false

operators.name: Not element of
operators.formula: x ∉ S  — x is not a member of S

operators.name: OR
operators.formula: A ∨ B is true when at least one is true

operators.name: Proper subset
operators.formula: A ⊂ B  — every element of A is in B and A ≠ B

operators.name: Set difference
operators.formula: A − B = elements of A that are not in B

operators.name: Subset or equal
operators.formula: A ⊆ B  — every element of A is in B

operators.name: There exists
operators.formula: ∃x ∈ D: P(x)  — P holds for at least one x in D

operators.name: Union
operators.formula: A ∪ B = elements in A or B (or both)

operators.name: XOR
operators.formula: A ⊕ B is true when exactly one is true

operators.name: Bisection method
operators.formula: Repeatedly halve [a, b] keeping the half where f changes sign

operators.name: Convex function
operators.formula: f(tx + (1−t)y) ≤ t·f(x) + (1−t)·f(y) for t in [0, 1]

operators.name: Euler's method
operators.formula: yₙ₊₁ = yₙ + h · f(xₙ, yₙ)   (returns list of (x, y) points)

operators.name: Fixed-point iteration
operators.formula: xₙ₊₁ = g(xₙ)

operators.name: Gauss-Seidel iteration
operators.formula: Like Jacobi but uses the newest values immediately

operators.name: Gaussian elimination
operators.formula: Reduce [A | b] to upper-triangular form, then back-substitute

operators.name: Gradient descent
operators.formula: Repeat xₖ₊₁ = xₖ − η ∇f(xₖ)

operators.name: Hessian
operators.formula: Hᵢⱼ = ∂²f / ∂xᵢ∂xⱼ  (matrix of second partial derivatives)

operators.name: Jacobi iteration
operators.formula: xᵢ⁽ᵏ⁺¹⁾ = (bᵢ − Σ_{j≠i} Aᵢⱼ xⱼ⁽ᵏ⁾) / Aᵢᵢ

operators.name: KKT conditions
operators.formula: Necessary conditions for optimality under inequality constraints: stationarity, feasibility, complementary slackness

operators.name: Lagrange interpolation
operators.formula: L(x) = Σᵢ yᵢ ∏_{j≠i} (x − xⱼ) / (xᵢ − xⱼ)

operators.name: Lagrange multipliers
operators.formula: Extrema of f subject to g = 0 occur where ∇f = λ ∇g

operators.name: Least squares
operators.formula: Best-fit line y = mx + b minimizing squared error; returns (slope, intercept)
operators.pattern: min Σ ( □ ᵢ − □ ᵢ ) ² with □ = □

operators.name: Linear programming
operators.formula: Maximize cᵀx subject to Ax ≤ b, x ≥ 0

operators.name: Maximize
operators.formula: Find x that makes f(x) as large as possible (minimize −f)

operators.name: Minimize
operators.formula: Find x that makes f(x) as small as possible

operators.name: Newton interpolation
operators.formula: N(x) = c₀ + c₁(x − x₀) + c₂(x − x₀)(x − x₁) + …  (divided differences)

operators.name: Newton's method
operators.formula: xₙ₊₁ = xₙ − f(xₙ) / f′(xₙ)

operators.name: Runge-Kutta (RK4)
operators.formula: yₙ₊₁ = yₙ + h/6 · (k₁ + 2k₂ + 2k₃ + k₄)

operators.name: Secant method
operators.formula: xₙ₊₁ = xₙ − f(xₙ)(xₙ − xₙ₋₁) / (f(xₙ) − f(xₙ₋₁))

operators.name: Simplex method
operators.formula: Algorithm that walks along vertices of the feasible region to solve a linear program

operators.name: Simpson's rule
operators.formula: ∫ₐᵇ f ≈ h/3 · (f₀ + 4f₁ + 2f₂ + … + fₙ),  n even

operators.name: Spline
operators.formula: A piecewise polynomial (often cubic) joined smoothly at knots

operators.name: Trapezoid rule
operators.formula: ∫ₐᵇ f ≈ h · (f(a)/2 + Σ f(xᵢ) + f(b)/2),  h = (b − a)/n

operators.name: Almost everywhere
operators.formula: A property holding except on a set of measure zero

operators.name: Alternating series test
operators.formula: Converges if aₙ decreases to 0

operators.name: Banach space
operators.formula: A complete normed vector space

operators.name: Comparison test
operators.formula: If 0 ≤ aₙ ≤ bₙ and Σbₙ converges then Σaₙ converges

operators.name: Convergence
operators.formula: aₙ → L if for every ε > 0 there is N with |aₙ − L| < ε for all n > N

operators.name: Epsilon-delta continuity
operators.formula: f is continuous at a if ∀ε>0 ∃δ>0: |x − a| < δ ⇒ |f(x) − f(a)| < ε

operators.name: Hilbert space
operators.formula: A complete inner-product space

operators.name: Infimum
operators.formula: greatest lower bound of a set (for a finite set, the minimum)

operators.name: Inner product
operators.formula: ⟨x, y⟩ = Σ xᵢyᵢ   (real vectors)

operators.name: Integral test
operators.formula: For positive decreasing f, Σ f(n) and ∫ f(x) dx converge or diverge together

operators.name: Intermediate value theorem
operators.formula: If f is continuous on [a, b] then f takes every value between f(a) and f(b)

operators.name: Lebesgue integral
operators.formula: Integral defined by approximating f with simple functions and measuring their level sets

operators.name: Limit inferior
operators.formula: lim inf aₙ = lim_{n→∞} inf{ aₖ : k ≥ n }

operators.name: Limit superior
operators.formula: lim sup aₙ = lim_{n→∞} sup{ aₖ : k ≥ n }

operators.name: Lipschitz ratio
operators.formula: |f(x) − f(y)| ≤ K |x − y|;  this returns |f(x) − f(y)| / |x − y|

operators.name: Lp norm
operators.formula: ‖f‖ₚ = (∫|f|ᵖ dx)^(1/p)   (numerical, Riemann sum)

operators.name: Mean value theorem
operators.formula: f′(c) = (f(b) − f(a)) / (b − a) for some c in (a, b)

operators.name: Measure
operators.formula: A function assigning size to sets: μ(∅) = 0 and countably additive on disjoint sets

operators.name: Outer measure
operators.formula: μ*(A) = inf { Σ μ(Iₖ) : A ⊆ ∪ Iₖ }

operators.name: Radius of convergence
operators.formula: R = 1 / L  where L = lim |aₙ₊₁ / aₙ|

operators.name: Ratio test
operators.formula: L = lim |aₙ₊₁ / aₙ|;  converges if L < 1, diverges if L > 1

operators.name: Riemann sum
operators.formula: Σ f(xᵢ) · Δx   (left endpoints, n subintervals)
operators.pattern: Σ f ( x ᵢ ) · Δx with □ , □ , □ , □ = □

operators.name: Riemann–Stieltjes sum
operators.formula: Σ f(xᵢ) · (g(xᵢ₊₁) − g(xᵢ))

operators.name: Root test
operators.formula: L = lim ⁿ√|aₙ|;  converges if L < 1, diverges if L > 1

operators.name: Series convergence test
operators.formula: Σ aₙ converges if its partial sums converge; use the ratio/root/comparison/integral tests

operators.name: Sigma-algebra
operators.formula: A collection of sets closed under complement and countable unions, containing the whole space

operators.name: Supremum
operators.formula: least upper bound of a set (for a finite set, the maximum)

operators.name: Uniform continuity
operators.formula: ∀ε>0 ∃δ>0 (independent of x): |x − y| < δ ⇒ |f(x) − f(y)| < ε

operators.name: Uniform convergence
operators.formula: sup_x |fₙ(x) − f(x)| → 0 as n → ∞

operators.name: Bayes' theorem
operators.formula: P(A|B) = P(B|A) · P(A) / P(B)

operators.name: Binomial distribution
operators.formula: P(X = k) = C(n,k) · pᵏ · (1−p)ⁿ⁻ᵏ

operators.name: Chi-square statistic
operators.formula: χ² = Σ (Oᵢ − Eᵢ)² / Eᵢ
operators.pattern: □ ² = Σ ( □ ᵢ − □ ᵢ ) ² / □ ᵢ

operators.name: Conditional probability
operators.formula: P(A|B) = P(A ∩ B) / P(B)

operators.name: Correlation
operators.formula: r = cov(X,Y) / (sₓ · s_y)

operators.name: Covariance
operators.formula: cov(X,Y) = Σ(xᵢ − x̄)(yᵢ − ȳ) / (n − 1)

operators.name: Expected square
operators.formula: E[X²] = Σ xᵢ² · pᵢ

operators.name: Expected value
operators.formula: E[X] = Σ xᵢ · pᵢ

operators.name: Exponential distribution
operators.formula: f(x) = λ · e^(−λx) for x ≥ 0

operators.name: First quartile
operators.formula: Q1, the 25th percentile (quantiles of the list in four parts, the first cut)

operators.name: Interquartile range
operators.formula: IQR = Q3 − Q1

operators.name: Interquartile range: from the quartiles
operators.formula: IQR = Q3 − Q1   (Q3 is the answer of Row 1, Q1 the answer of Row 2)

operators.name: Linear regression
operators.formula: least-squares line; returns (slope, intercept)

operators.name: Maximum of a list
operators.formula: max of the list

operators.name: Minimum of a list
operators.formula: min of the list

operators.name: Mean
operators.formula: mean = Σxᵢ / n

operators.name: Median
operators.formula: middle value of the sorted data (average of the two middle values if n is even)

operators.name: Mode
operators.formula: most frequent value

operators.name: Normal distribution
operators.formula: f(x) = e^(−(x−μ)² / 2σ²) / (σ√(2π))   (probability density)

operators.name: p-value
operators.formula: probability, assuming the null hypothesis is true, of a result at least as extreme as the one observed

operators.name: Percentile
operators.formula: value below which k percent of the data fall (k = 1 … 99)

operators.name: Poisson distribution
operators.formula: P(X = k) = λᵏ · e^(−λ) / k!

operators.name: Probability
operators.formula: P(A) = favorable outcomes / total outcomes

operators.name: Quartiles
operators.formula: values that split sorted data into four equal parts

operators.name: Range
operators.formula: range = max − min

operators.name: Range: from the ends
operators.formula: range = max − min   (max is the answer of Row 1, min the answer of Row 2)

operators.name: Sample standard deviation
operators.formula: s = √(s²)

operators.name: Sample standard deviation: from the sample variance
operators.formula: s = √(s²)   (s² is the answer of the row above)

operators.name: Sample variance
operators.formula: s² = Σ(xᵢ − x̄)² / (n − 1)

operators.name: Standard deviation
operators.formula: σ = √(σ²)   (population)

operators.name: Standard deviation: from the variance
operators.formula: σ = √(σ²)   (σ² is the answer of the row above)

operators.name: t-test statistic
operators.formula: t = (x̄ − μ₀) / (s / √n)   (one-sample)

operators.name: Third quartile
operators.formula: Q3, the 75th percentile (quantiles of the list in four parts, the third cut)

operators.name: Uniform distribution
operators.formula: f(x) = 1 / (b − a) for a ≤ x ≤ b, else 0

operators.name: Variance
operators.formula: σ² = Σ(xᵢ − μ)² / n   (population)

operators.name: Variance: from the expectations
operators.formula: Var = E[X²] − (E[X])²   (E[X²] is the answer of Row 2, E[X] the answer of Row 1)

operators.name: Variance of random variable
operators.formula: Var(X) = E[X²] − (E[X])²

operators.name: Z-score
operators.formula: z = (x − μ) / σ

operators.name: Basis of topology
operators.formula: A collection of open sets such that every open set is a union of members of ℬ

operators.name: Boundary
operators.formula: ∂A = Ā − A°

operators.name: Cauchy sequence
operators.formula: For every ε > 0 there is N with d(xₘ, xₙ) < ε for all m, n > N

operators.name: Closed set
operators.formula: A set whose complement is open

operators.name: Closure
operators.formula: Smallest closed set containing A

operators.name: Cohomology
operators.formula: Dual to homology: Hⁿ = ker δⁿ / im δⁿ⁻¹

operators.name: Compact
operators.formula: Every open cover has a finite subcover

operators.name: Complete space
operators.formula: Every Cauchy sequence converges

operators.name: Connected
operators.formula: Cannot be split into two disjoint non-empty open sets
operators.pattern: No separation into two open pieces with □

operators.name: Continuous map
operators.formula: f is continuous if the preimage of every open set is open

operators.name: Covering space
operators.formula: A map where every point has a neighborhood evenly covered by p

operators.name: Euler characteristic
operators.formula: χ = V − E + F   (vertices − edges + faces)

operators.name: Fundamental group
operators.formula: The group of loops at a base point, up to homotopy

operators.name: Hausdorff
operators.formula: Any two distinct points have disjoint open neighborhoods
operators.pattern: x ≠ y ⇒ ∃ open U , V with x ∈ U , y ∈ V , U ∩ V = ∅ with □

operators.name: Homeomorphism
operators.formula: A continuous bijection with continuous inverse

operators.name: Homology
operators.formula: Hₙ = ker ∂ₙ / im ∂ₙ₊₁

operators.name: Homotopy
operators.formula: A continuous deformation of one map into another

operators.name: Interior
operators.formula: Largest open set contained in A

operators.name: Manifold
operators.formula: A space that locally looks like ℝⁿ

operators.name: Metric space distance
operators.formula: d(x, y) = √Σ(xᵢ − yᵢ)²   (Euclidean metric)

operators.name: Neighborhood
operators.formula: A set containing an open set that contains x

operators.name: Open ball
operators.formula: B(x, r) = { y : d(x, y) < r };  returns True if y is in the ball

operators.name: Open set
operators.formula: A set U in a topology τ  (a member of τ)
operators.pattern: x ∈ U ⇒ some ball around x lies in U with □ , □

operators.name: Path-connected
operators.formula: Any two points are joined by a continuous path

operators.name: Product topology
operators.formula: Topology generated by open rectangles U × V

operators.name: Subspace topology
operators.formula: τ_A = { U ∩ A : U ∈ τ }

operators.name: Characteristic equation
operators.formula: For ay″ + by′ + cy = 0 try y = e^(rx) and solve the quadratic for r

operators.name: Convolution
operators.formula: (f ∗ g)[k] = Σⱼ f[j] · g[k − j]

operators.name: Dirac delta
operators.formula: δ(x) = 0 for x ≠ 0 and ∫ δ(x) dx = 1

operators.name: Discrete Fourier transform
operators.formula: Xₖ = Σₙ xₙ · e^(−2πi·kn/N)

operators.name: First-order ODE
operators.formula: An ordinary differential equation involving only the first derivative

operators.name: Fourier series
operators.formula: f(x) = a₀/2 + Σ (aₙ cos nx + bₙ sin nx),  aₙ = (1/π)∫f cos nx dx,  bₙ = (1/π)∫f sin nx dx
operators.pattern: f ( □ ) = Σ □ ₙ cos ( n □ ) + □ ₙ sin ( n □ ) with □ , □

operators.name: Heat equation
operators.formula: ∂u/∂t = α ∂²u/∂x²

operators.name: Heaviside step
operators.formula: H(x) = 0 for x < 0, 1 for x > 0 (½ at 0)

operators.name: Integrating factor
operators.formula: For y′ + P(x)y = Q(x):  μ = e^(∫P dx),  (μy)′ = μQ

operators.name: Inverse discrete Fourier transform
operators.formula: xₙ = (1/N) Σₖ Xₖ · e^(2πi·kn/N)

operators.name: Inverse Laplace transform
operators.formula: f(t) = (1 / 2πi) ∫ F(s) e^(st) ds

operators.name: Laplace's equation
operators.formula: ∂²u/∂x² + ∂²u/∂y² + ∂²u/∂z² = 0

operators.name: Laplace transform
operators.formula: F(s) = ∫₀^∞ f(t) e^(−st) dt

operators.name: Partial differential equation
operators.formula: An equation involving partial derivatives of a function of several variables

operators.name: Power series solution
operators.formula: Substitute a power series into the ODE and solve for the coefficients cₙ

operators.name: Second-order ODE
operators.formula: An ordinary differential equation involving up to the second derivative

operators.name: Separable equation
operators.formula: Rewrite as dy/h(y) = g(x) dx and integrate both sides

operators.name: Variation of parameters
operators.formula: Particular solution yₚ = −y₁∫(y₂ g / W) dx + y₂∫(y₁ g / W) dx

operators.name: Wave equation
operators.formula: ∂²u/∂t² = c² ∂²u/∂x²

operators.name: Wronskian
operators.formula: W(f, g) = f·g′ − g·f′   (f, g and their derivatives at a point)

operators.name: Z-transform
operators.formula: X(z) = Σₙ x[n] · z⁻ⁿ

operators.name: Angle sum
operators.formula: sin(a + b) = sin a cos b + cos a sin b

operators.name: Cosecant
operators.formula: csc θ = 1 / sin θ

operators.name: Cosine
operators.formula: cos θ = adjacent / hypotenuse   (θ in radians)

operators.name: Cotangent
operators.formula: cot θ = cos θ / sin θ

operators.name: Degrees to radians
operators.formula: radians = degrees × π / 180

operators.name: Double angle
operators.formula: sin 2θ = 2 sin θ cos θ

operators.name: Half angle
operators.formula: sin(θ/2) = √((1 − cos θ) / 2)   (for θ/2 in the first two quadrants)

operators.name: Hyperbolic cosine
operators.formula: cosh x = (eˣ + e⁻ˣ) / 2

operators.name: Hyperbolic sine
operators.formula: sinh x = (eˣ − e⁻ˣ) / 2

operators.name: Hyperbolic tangent
operators.formula: tanh x = sinh x / cosh x

operators.name: Inverse cosine
operators.formula: θ = arccos(x),  −1 ≤ x ≤ 1

operators.name: Inverse hyperbolic cosine
operators.formula: acosh x = ln(x + √(x² − 1)),  x ≥ 1

operators.name: Inverse hyperbolic sine
operators.formula: asinh x = ln(x + √(x² + 1))

operators.name: Inverse hyperbolic tangent
operators.formula: atanh x = ½ ln((1 + x)/(1 − x)),  |x| < 1

operators.name: Inverse sine
operators.formula: θ = arcsin(x),  −1 ≤ x ≤ 1

operators.name: Inverse tangent
operators.formula: θ = arctan(x)

operators.name: Pythagorean identity
operators.formula: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1  (function returns the left side, always 1)

operators.name: Radians to degrees
operators.formula: degrees = radians × 180 / π

operators.name: Secant
operators.formula: sec θ = 1 / cos θ

operators.name: Sine
operators.formula: sin θ = opposite / hypotenuse   (θ in radians)

operators.name: Tangent
operators.formula: tan θ = sin θ / cos θ

operators.name: Two-argument arctangent
operators.formula: atan2(y, x) = angle of the point (x, y) from the +x axis

operators.name: Acceleration
operators.formula: a = Δv / t

operators.name: Bernoulli's equation
operators.formula: P₂ = P₁ + ½ρ(v₁² − v₂²) + ρg(h₁ − h₂)   (g = 9.81 m/s²)
operators.compute_signature: compute(P1, v1, h1, v2, h2, rho, g=9.81)

operators.name: Bohr energy level (hydrogen-like atom)
operators.formula: Eₙ = −13.605693 eV × Z² / n²   (energy in electron-volts)

operators.name: Braking time
operators.formula: t = −u / a   (the time until the speed is 0; a must oppose u)

operators.name: Brewster's angle
operators.formula: θB = arctan(n₂ / n₁)   (angle in radians)

operators.name: Buoyant force (Archimedes' principle)
operators.formula: F = ρ g V   (g = 9.81 m/s²)

operators.name: Capacitance
operators.formula: Q = C V

operators.name: Centripetal acceleration
operators.formula: a = v² / r

operators.name: Compton wavelength shift
operators.formula: Δλ = h / (m c) × (1 − cos θ)   (scattering off an electron by default)

operators.name: Continuity equation
operators.formula: v₂ = A₁ v₁ / A₂   (incompressible fluid)

operators.name: Coulomb's law
operators.formula: F = k q₁ q₂ / r²   (k = 8.988×10⁹ N·m²/C²)

operators.name: Critical angle (total internal reflection)
operators.formula: θc = arcsin(n₂ / n₁)   (n₁ > n₂, angle in radians)

operators.name: Cyclotron radius of a charged particle
operators.formula: r = m v / (|q| B)   (charge moving perpendicular to B)

operators.name: de Broglie wavelength
operators.formula: λ = h / (m v)   (h = 6.62607015×10⁻³⁴ J·s, non-relativistic)

operators.name: Density
operators.formula: ρ = m / V

operators.name: Diffraction grating
operators.formula: θ = arcsin(m λ / d)   (angle in radians)

operators.name: Displacement
operators.formula: s = u t + ½ a t²

operators.name: Double-slit fringe spacing
operators.formula: Δy = λ L / d   (small angles)

operators.name: Electric power
operators.formula: P = I V

operators.name: Energy-momentum relation
operators.formula: E = √( (p c)² + (m c²)² )   (total energy)

operators.name: Faraday's law of induction
operators.formula: ε = −N ΔΦ / Δt

operators.name: Final velocity
operators.formula: v = u + a t

operators.name: Frequency
operators.formula: f = 1 / T

operators.name: Gravitation
operators.formula: F = G m₁ m₂ / r²   (G = 6.674×10⁻¹¹ N·m²/kg²)

operators.name: Gravitational time dilation
operators.formula: Δt₀ = Δt √(1 − 2GM/(r c²))   (clock at distance r from mass M, r > rₛ)

operators.name: Gravitational time dilation: from the horizon
operators.formula: Δt₀ = Δt √(1 − rₛ/r)   (rₛ is the answer of the row above; r > rₛ)

operators.name: Heat
operators.formula: Q = m c ΔT

operators.name: Heisenberg uncertainty principle
operators.formula: Δp ≥ ħ / (2 Δx)   (returns the smallest possible Δp)

operators.name: Hooke's law
operators.formula: F = −k x

operators.name: Hover thrust
operators.formula: T = m g   (the upward force that balances the weight, g = 9.81 m/s²)

operators.name: Hydraulic press (Pascal's principle)
operators.formula: F₂ = F₁ A₂ / A₁   (pressure is the same everywhere in the fluid)

operators.name: Hydrostatic pressure
operators.formula: P = ρ g h   (pressure due to the fluid alone, g = 9.81 m/s²)

operators.name: Ideal gas law
operators.formula: P = n R T / V   (R = 8.314 J/(mol·K))

operators.name: Impulse
operators.formula: J = F Δt

operators.name: Energy stored in an inductor
operators.formula: U = ½ L I²

operators.name: Kinetic energy
operators.formula: KE = ½ m v²

operators.name: Length contraction
operators.formula: L = L₀ √(1 − v²/c²)   (L₀ = length at rest)

operators.name: Length contraction: from the Lorentz factor
operators.formula: L = L₀ / γ   (γ is the answer of the row above)

operators.name: Lens magnification
operators.formula: m = −dᵢ / dₒ   (negative m means an inverted image)

operators.name: Lensmaker's equation
operators.formula: f = 1 / ( (n − 1)(1/R₁ − 1/R₂) )   (thin lens in air)

operators.name: Magnetic field inside a solenoid
operators.formula: B = μ₀ n I   (n = turns per metre, μ₀ = 4π×10⁻⁷ T·m/A)

operators.name: Magnetic field of a straight wire
operators.formula: B = μ₀ I / (2π r)   (μ₀ = 4π×10⁻⁷ T·m/A)

operators.name: Magnetic flux
operators.formula: Φ = B A cos θ   (θ = angle between B and the surface normal, radians)

operators.name: Magnetic force on a moving charge
operators.formula: F = q v B sin θ   (θ = angle between v and B, radians)

operators.name: Magnetic force on a current-carrying wire
operators.formula: F = B I L sin θ   (θ = angle between wire and B, radians)

operators.name: Malus's law
operators.formula: I = I₀ cos²θ   (θ = angle between polariser axes, radians)

operators.name: Momentum
operators.formula: p = m v

operators.name: Motional emf
operators.formula: ε = B L v   (rod of length L moving at speed v across B)

operators.name: Navier–Stokes: continuity (incompressible)
operators.formula: ∂u/∂x + ∂v/∂y + ∂w/∂z = 0   (incompressible flow)

operators.name: Navier–Stokes equation
operators.formula: ρ(∂u/∂t + (u·∇)u) = −∇p + μ∇²u + f   (incompressible flow, ∇·u = 0)

operators.name: Navier–Stokes: x momentum
operators.formula: ρ(∂u/∂t + u ∂u/∂x + v ∂u/∂y + w ∂u/∂z) = −∂p/∂x + μ(∂²u/∂x² + ∂²u/∂y² + ∂²u/∂z²) + f_x   (incompressible flow)
operators.pattern: ρ ( ∂ u / ∂ t + u ∂ u / ∂ x + v ∂ u / ∂ y + w ∂ u / ∂ z ) = − ∂ p / ∂ x + μ ( ∂ ² u / ∂ x ² + ∂ ² u / ∂ y ² + ∂ ² u / ∂ z ² ) + f x

operators.name: Navier–Stokes: y momentum
operators.formula: ρ(∂v/∂t + u ∂v/∂x + v ∂v/∂y + w ∂v/∂z) = −∂p/∂y + μ(∂²v/∂x² + ∂²v/∂y² + ∂²v/∂z²) + f_y   (incompressible flow)
operators.pattern: ρ ( ∂ v / ∂ t + u ∂ v / ∂ x + v ∂ v / ∂ y + w ∂ v / ∂ z ) = − ∂ p / ∂ y + μ ( ∂ ² v / ∂ x ² + ∂ ² v / ∂ y ² + ∂ ² v / ∂ z ² ) + f y

operators.name: Navier–Stokes: z momentum
operators.formula: ρ(∂w/∂t + u ∂w/∂x + v ∂w/∂y + w ∂w/∂z) = −∂p/∂z + μ(∂²w/∂x² + ∂²w/∂y² + ∂²w/∂z²) + f_z   (incompressible flow)
operators.pattern: ρ ( ∂ w / ∂ t + u ∂ w / ∂ x + v ∂ w / ∂ y + w ∂ w / ∂ z ) = − ∂ p / ∂ z + μ ( ∂ ² w / ∂ x ² + ∂ ² w / ∂ y ² + ∂ ² w / ∂ z ² ) + f z

operators.name: Newton's second law
operators.formula: F = m a

operators.name: Ohm's law
operators.formula: V = I R

operators.name: Pendulum period
operators.formula: T = 2π √(L / g)

operators.name: Photoelectric effect
operators.formula: K_max = h f − φ   (0 if h f < φ: no electrons are ejected)

operators.name: Poiseuille's law (flow in a pipe)
operators.formula: Q = π r⁴ ΔP / (8 μ L)   (laminar flow in a round pipe)

operators.name: Potential energy
operators.formula: PE = m g h

operators.name: Power (Physics)
operators.formula: P = W / t

operators.name: Pressure
operators.formula: P = F / A

operators.name: Projectile position
operators.formula: x = v cos θ · t,  y = v sin θ · t − ½ g t²   (y is up, no drag, g = 9.81 m/s²)

operators.name: Projectile range
operators.formula: R = v² sin(2θ) / g   (level ground, no drag, g = 9.81 m/s², θ in radians)

operators.name: Projectile time of flight
operators.formula: T = 2 v sin θ / g   (back to the same height, no drag, g = 9.81 m/s², θ in radians)

operators.name: Quantum harmonic oscillator
operators.formula: Eₙ = ħ ω (n + ½)   (ω in rad/s)

operators.name: Relativistic Doppler: beta
operators.formula: β = v / c   (v > 0 receding, v < 0 approaching; the speed must be less than the speed of light)

operators.name: Relativistic Doppler effect
operators.formula: f = f₀ √( (1 − β)/(1 + β) ),  β = v/c   (v > 0 receding, v < 0 approaching)

operators.name: Relativistic Doppler: frequency
operators.formula: f = f₀ √( (1 − β)/(1 + β) )   (β is the answer of the row above)

operators.name: Relativistic kinetic energy: from the Lorentz factor
operators.formula: K = (γ − 1) m c²   (γ is the answer of the row above)

operators.name: Relativistic momentum
operators.formula: p = m v / √(1 − v²/c²)

operators.name: Relativistic momentum: from the Lorentz factor
operators.formula: p = γ m v   (γ is the answer of the row above)

operators.name: Relativistic velocity addition
operators.formula: w = (u + v) / (1 + u v / c²)

operators.name: Resistors in parallel
operators.formula: 1 / R_total = 1/R₁ + 1/R₂ + …

operators.name: Resistors in series
operators.formula: R_total = R₁ + R₂ + …

operators.name: Reynolds number
operators.formula: Re = ρ v L / μ   (μ = dynamic viscosity)

operators.name: Schwarzschild radius
operators.formula: rₛ = 2 G M / c²   (G = 6.674×10⁻¹¹ N·m²/kg²)

operators.name: Self-induced emf of an inductor
operators.formula: ε = −L ΔI / Δt

operators.name: Snell's law
operators.formula: θ₂ = arcsin(n₁ sin θ₁ / n₂)   (angles in radians)

operators.name: Speed after a distance
operators.formula: v = √(u² + 2 a s)   (u in m/s, a in m/s², s in metres along the line)

operators.name: Stokes' drag force
operators.formula: F = 6π μ r v   (small sphere, slow flow)

operators.name: Stopping distance
operators.formula: s = −u² / (2 a)   (the signed displacement until the speed is 0; a must oppose u)

operators.name: Thin lens equation
operators.formula: dᵢ = 1 / (1/f − 1/dₒ)   (returns the image distance, real-is-positive)

operators.name: Time dilation
operators.formula: Δt = Δt₀ / √(1 − v²/c²)   (Δt₀ = time measured by the moving clock)

operators.name: Time dilation: from the Lorentz factor
operators.formula: Δt = Δt₀ γ   (γ is the answer of the row above)

operators.name: Time to a distance
operators.formula: the smallest t ≥ 0 with s = u t + ½ a t²   (s is the signed displacement)

operators.name: Torque
operators.formula: τ = r F sin θ

operators.name: Velocity
operators.formula: v = d / t

operators.name: Velocity squared
operators.formula: v = √(u² + 2 a s)

operators.name: Volume flow rate
operators.formula: Q = A v

operators.name: Wave speed
operators.formula: v = f λ

operators.name: Weight
operators.formula: W = m g   (g = 9.81 m/s²)

operators.name: Work
operators.formula: W = F d   (force parallel to displacement)
